source_documents.name: TensorRT for RTX 1.6 Release Notes
source_documents.observed_semantics: Runtime cache compatibility tightened: GPU SKU, TensorRT-RTX version and CiG state must match; runtime driver must be greater than or equal to the cached driver version.

source_documents.name: Working with Runtime Cache
source_documents.observed_semantics: On compatibility failure the runtime cache is ignored and kernels are JIT-compiled again without raising an error; cache use can be verified through application logs or profiling/JIT timing.

source_documents.name: TensorRT-RTX 1.5 Release Notes
source_documents.observed_semantics: Timing cache APIs are deprecated and timing cache has no effect on the built TensorRT-RTX engine.
